# StudioCue

> StudioCue (also written Studio Cue) gives photography studios Cue, an office manager that works every hour, from the first inquiry to the final gallery. Cue does the routine work on its own (acknowledging inquiries, signing and form reminders, invoices from QuickBooks, offering a job to the next photographer, chasing insurance certificates, the week-before note, review and album reminders) and prepares the rest for the studio to approve: the reply, the proposal, the run of show, the crew offer. Couples and crew get their own app in the studio's name. Website: https://studio-cue.com

StudioCue is for wedding photographers first, and also family and portrait sessions, corporate events and sports. Couples use a portal on any phone (nothing to download); second shooters and assistants get a crew app with offers, call times and day sheets. Cue never records a payment, a signature or a permission on its own, never marks a job ready, and never touches the photos. Couples never deal with Cue: everything they see comes from the studio. Invoices and payments go through the studio's own QuickBooks; StudioCue never takes a cut of client payments. Agreements are written from the accepted proposal and signed online in StudioCue. Pricing: Studio $150/month, Multi-Brand $299/month; 14-day trial, card required, nothing charged for 14 days.
